exercises.q: I want to travel around the world.
exercises.why: **объехать** — объе́хать (perfective): to travel (all over); to go round, to make a detour, to take the bypass. Wiktionary: об- + е́хать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does о- add in обойти́ (“to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around)”)?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists обойти́ under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

**обошли** — обойти́ (perfective): to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area); to overtake, to outrank, to beat, to outperform (a peer or competitor); to evade, to circumvent, to avoid, to bypass (the law etc.). Wiktionary: обо- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **обошёл** — обойти́ (perfective): to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area); to overtake, to outrank, to beat, to outperform (a peer or competitor); to evade, to circumvent, to avoid, to bypass (the law etc.). Wiktionary: обо- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does о- add in оше́йник (“collar (e.g. on a dog or a cat)”)?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
turning into something, giving it particular properties
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists оше́йник under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 15 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does о- add in окра́ина (“outskirts (the edges or areas around a city or town)”)?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
spreading the action over the whole object, its whole surface or volume
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists окра́ина under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 9 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around)
collar (e.g. on a dog or a cat)
outskirts (the edges or areas around a city or town)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: объе́хать — to travel (all over); обойти́ — to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); оше́йник — collar (e.g. on a dog or a cat); окра́ина — outskirts (the edges or areas around a city or town).
